title: Charlotte Tilbury taps Christina Aguilera to front 2026 Christmas campaign
summary: The 45-year-old Grammy Award-winning artist is the face of the Puig-owned make-up brand’s 2026 holiday campaign, which pays homage to the showgirl glamour featured in Christina Aguilera’s 2001 hit song Lady Marmalade

extraction.key_fact: 샬롯 틸버리가 크리스티나 아길레라를 크리스마스 홀리데이 캠페인 모델로 발탁했다.
